guarantees: stop is individual and idempotent, rejects stale callbacks and drains all already started work.
Pending user scans and remaining users cannot enqueue after stop.
Daily reports already started are awaited.
An uncooperative scan makes runtime shutdown fail at its deadline and cannot enqueue after later resolution.
All cron expressions are validated before creating any timer.
If task construction fails, partially created tasks are stopped and destroyed.
limits: No external database, Redis, provider or business effect was contacted.
An enqueue already started before stop is awaited; it is not cancelled.
A running daily report drains within the runtime global shutdown deadline.
